content.text:
I haven't submitted the model, and it is incomplete. The web_search tool hit its usage limit after I'd collected data for only two companies. It then returned "Server tool use limit exceeded" on every call.

I tried to submit anyway, with nulls and "not found" in the missing fields. `submit_model` rejected it because `market_cap` must be a number. I have no cited market cap for any company. I didn't fill the gaps from memory, because every number needs a source I can name.

**Sourced figures (USD millions, FY2025, year ended 31 Dec 2025)**

| | Exxon Mobil (target) | Chevron |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 332,238 | 189,031 |
| EBITDA | 67,864 | 41,092 |
| Net income | 28,844 | 12,299 |
| Net debt | 32,856 | 34,461 |
| Market cap | not found | not found |

- **Exxon Mobil revenue and net income:** From the FY2025 10-K (accession 0000034088-26-000045). Revenue is "Total revenues and other income", and net income is the amount attributable to ExxonMobil.
- **Exxon Mobil EBITDA:** Pre-tax income of 41,268, plus interest expense of 603, plus depreciation and depletion (including impairments) of 25,993.
- **Exxon Mobil net debt:** Total debt of 43,537 (notes and loans payable 9,296 plus long-term debt 34,241), less cash of 10,681. Exxon's own release also gives total debt of $43.5 billion less $10.7 billion of cash.
- **Chevron revenue and net income:** From the FY2025 10-K (accession 0000093410-26-000078) and the 2025 Annual Report Supplement. Revenue is "Total revenues and other income".
- **Chevron EBITDA:** Pre-tax income of 19,743, plus interest and debt expense of 1,217 (from the 4Q25 earnings release), plus DD&A of 20,132.
- **Chevron net debt:** From the 4Q25 release. Total debt of 40,758 includes finance leases, less cash of 6,293 and time deposits of 4. Chevron holds no marketable securities. Because of the finance leases, this slightly overstates net debt under your "excluding leases" convention.

**Still missing**
- Market caps for both companies.
- All five figures for the remaining peers I planned: ConocoPhillips, Shell, TotalEnergies, and BP or Eni. The comps table needs 4 to 6 peers, and I have only one (Chevron).

**To finish:** Rerun with web search restored. The remaining work is the FY2025 filings for three or four more peers and a cited market cap for each of the six companies. I can then submit the full model.
